answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sparrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work. Every claim climbs the ferrous of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the canyon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
